text: Ah! Rebellious children,oracle of the Lord,Who carry out a plan that is not mine,who make an alliance [2] I did not inspire,thus adding sin upon sin; [AA]
They go down to Egypt,without asking my counsel, [3]To seek strength in Pharaoh's protectionand take refuge in Egypt's shadow. [AB]
Pharaoh's protection shall become your shame,refuge in Egypt's shadow your disgrace. [AC]
When his princes are at Zoanand his messengers reach Hanes, [AD]
All shall be ashamedof a people that gain them nothing,Neither help nor benefit,but only shame and reproach. [AE]

Oracle on the Beasts of the Negeb.Through the distressed and troubled land [4]of the lioness and roaring lion,of the viper and flying saraph,They carry their riches on the backs of donkeysand their treasures on the humps of camelsTo a people good for nothing,
to Egypt whose help is futile and vain.Therefore I call her"Rahab [5] Sit-still."
t[6] Now come, write it on a tablet they can keep,inscribe it on a scroll;That in time to come it may bean eternal witness. [AF]
For this is a rebellious people,deceitful children,Children who refuseto listen to the instruction of the Lord; [AG]
Who say to the seers, "Do not see";to the prophets, [7] "Do not prophesy truth for us;speak smooth things to us, see visions that deceive! [AH]
Turn aside from the way! Get out of the path!Let us hear no moreof the Holy One of Israel!" [AI]
Therefore, thus says the Holy One of Israel:Because you reject this word,And put your trust in oppression and deceit,and depend on them, [AJ]
This iniquity of yours shall belike a descending riftBulging out in a high wallwhose crash comes suddenly, in an instant, [AK]
Crashing like a potter's jarsmashed beyond rescue,And among its fragments cannot be founda sherd to scoop fire from the hearthor dip water from the cistern. [AL]
For thus said the Lord God,the Holy One of Israel:By waiting and by calm you shall be saved,in quiet and in trust shall be your strength.But this you did not will. [AM]
"No," you said,"Upon horses we will flee."Very well, you shall flee!"Upon swift steeds we will ride."Very well, swift shall be your pursuers! [AN]
A thousand shall tremble at the threat of one—if five threaten, you shall flee.You will then be left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop,like a flag on a hill. [AO]
Truly, the Lord is waiting to be gracious to you,truly, he shall rise to show you mercy;For the Lord is a God of justice:happy are all who wait for him! [AP]
Yes, people of Zion, dwelling in Jerusalem,you shall no longer weep;He will be most gracious to you when you cry out;as soon as he hears he will answer you. [AQ]
The Lord will give you bread in adversityand water in affliction.No longer will your Teacher [8] hide himself,but with your own eyes you shall see your Teacher, [AR]
And your ears shall hear a word behind you:"This is the way; walk in it,"when you would turn to the right or the left.
You shall defile your silver-plated idolsand your gold-covered images;You shall throw them away like filthy rags,you shall say, "Get out!" [AS]
He will give rain for the seedyou sow in the ground,And the bread that the soil produceswill be rich and abundant.On that day your cattle will grazein broad meadows; [AT]
The oxen and the donkeys that till the groundwill eat silage tossed to themwith shovel and pitchfork.
Upon every high mountain and lofty hillthere will be streams of running water.On the day of the great slaughter,when the towers fall,

The light of the moon will be like the light of the sun,and the light of the sun will be seven times greater,like the light of seven days,On the day the Lord binds up the wounds of his peopleand heals the bruises left by his blows. [AU]
See, the name of the Lord is coming from afar,burning with anger, heavy with threat,His lips filled with fury,tongue like a consuming fire, [AV]
Breath like an overflowing torrentthat reaches up to the neck!He will winnow the nations with a destructive winnowingand bridle the jaws of the peoples to send them astray. [AW]
For you, there will be singingas on a night when a feast is observed,And joy of heartas when one marches along with a fluteGoing to the mountain of the Lord,to the Rock of Israel.
The Lord will make his glorious voice heard,and reveal his arm coming downIn raging fury and flame of consuming fire,in tempest, and rainstorm, and hail. [AX]
For at the voice of the Lord, Assyria will be shattered,as he strikes with the rod;
And every sweep of the rod of his punishment,which the Lord will bring down on him,Will be accompanied by timbrels and lyres,while he wages war against him. [AY]

For his tophet [10] has long been ready,truly it is prepared for the king;His firepit made both deep and wide,with fire and firewood in abundance,And the breath of the Lord, like a stream of sulfur,setting it afire. [AZ]
